reviews.review:
I really enjoyed playing "Die after sunset", a responsive, easy to play and fun 3rd person shooter that is still in its early access stage.

I really liked the fun approach to the whole plot and its setting, especially the enemies called Murkors. Also caught my attention the vibrant, colourful and cute cartoon-style graphics that make the overall game experience very enjoyable.

Although there is not much content yet (2 characters, random events that you have to achieve while killing Murkors, 3 levels, unlockables, items, etc... we must consider that is an early access), it seems to me as a very promising game and I am very excited to see how it develops in the coming months.

Looking forward for the entire game.
reviews.developer_response:
Thank you for your feedback, we're glad you've enjoyed the game!
More content is on it's way (with a third character already out now)

We hope you check it out!

reviews.review: I played the early demo of this game and I had it in my radar for when a stable release would be available. The game is now reliable and stable and you can just focus on having fun :). If you are into these type of games, this one is definitely worth trying, it is notably fun to play, time flies while playing it. The gameplay is good, feels smooth and natural, it does what you'd expect. Its cartoon-style graphics are bright and colorful and so they are not very demanding in terms of hardware.
reviews.developer_response:
Thank you so much for your kind words and feedback!

We have had many exciting content updates since our initial Early Access release and would encourage you to give the game another go now to experience it for yourself!

reviews.review:
I like the feel of the gunplay, it feels fairly responsive when the enemies receive the bullets, the enemies engage in a pretty active maner and it doesn't feel frustrating at all. It is fun, you can esaily loose track of time battling enemies.

The graphics and the aesthetics are cute, but it can feel generic at the main characters.
Sometimes the main characters feel a little bit unbalanced because you can get rapidly killed with the one with the pistol without notincing your life bar decreasing, while withe the rifle one you can run away of the enemies easier so your life never gets touched at all.

I have played five or six rounds and I would like to have unlocked more stuff in that invested time.

It felt weird to fall from higher altitudes to the water and take shield damage while not having any damage at all when falling on ground, in the bright side, it was intuitive to jump to the water to scape from enemies.

I loved the platforming style, but it got glitchy with the animations at some mountain stone corners.

The enemies are fun to battle, but I would appreciate more rewards from killing them, not only coins and so little quantity of life.

I feel like it is unnecessary to pay in coins for using one skill, I would like to see a limited amount of uses that I can carry around and then make the enemies drop the item.

It would be nice to see the cooldown of the main skills at the crosshair.

The final boss was great, it would be nice to have more variety on the attacks.

Would be super cool to have the possibility to play with friends co-op.

The enemies spawning is ok right now but it could be nicer if the enemies spawn in certain areas where you see them from far or where you can have certain amount of control over the situation, like spawnspots. 

The game doesn't hint in any way that when you win the boss it triggers the start of a new level, and it is very frustrating not having the possibility of starting from the new unlocked level directly.

I hope in the future the game features a horde mode mixed with tower defense mechanics.

If the game continues this way with this service-like style, if the developers listen to what their community says, and finally, if it gets a chace to learn to communicate through it's UI and interaction with the player in a more intuitive-natural way, it could become a doble AA-indie game that could be played by Twitch people organically and people with friends.

The game has addictive mechanics and a great visual work, it is really fun to play, totally recommended to be a early-access.
reviews.developer_response:
Hello there,

Thank you for your in depth feedback, we are very grateful for all that you reviewed about the game. With constructive feedback such as this, we have been able to continue developing and improving the game for you to enjoy.

In regards to more rewards from killing enemies, we have a mucus collecting system that would allow for meta-progression within the game and the rewards for using this system are very useful for creating a better build with your character as you play.

We have worked to improve and patch any glitches as we hear about them, so the game is running much more smoothly now and in turn so are the characters and enemies also within the environments.

With each level we have harder boss battles with much more variety in attack style and the way in which you must battle them as a result, this has made the gaming experience much more challenging and exciting.

We do plan to implement difficulty settings also at some point in the future for those that seek more of a challenge and co-op with friends is also on the cards in future content updates so please look out for those.

In the meantime, we would love for you to jump back in and experience the game once more now we have come further in our Early Access phase!
